current_activity: division enters combat in the XII Corps zone before the Moselle crossing (CMH: entered combat 12 March 1945)
notes: Event date: 12 March 1945 (CMH ETO-OB chronology for the 89th Infantry Division: arrived on the Continent 22 January 1945, entered combat 12 March 1945). Event definition: the CMH page dates the division's entry into combat; the table lists XII Corps and Third Army from 4 March; the crossing of the Moselle is dated separately in conflict group G017. Relationship: XII Corps unspecified_subordination (from 4 Mar 45 to 22 Mar 45, CMH table); Third Army assigned (from 4 Mar 45, CMH table); 12th Army Group assigned (from 18 Jan 45, CMH table). The table entries start on the first row of the unbroken run (convention V-013). The CMH table has a single corps column and does not say assigned or attached for a corps. Location: Gillenfeld (CMH ETO-OB command-post list, R530 p. 329: listed 13 March 1945; 1 day after the row); the town centre stands for the command post. Coordinates: Wikipedia (en): Gillenfeld. Event support: moderate (CMH page only). Location support: moderate (nearest later command post, 1 day after the row; the position on the date is not documented).
